name: Retriever
description: A brief description of what this plugin does.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the Retriever server, e.g. http://192.0.2.10:42511. Use an IP address if the name does not resolve.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shared token configured on the server.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to fetch new data.

_teaser_comment: One line of literal board text, max 15 tiles (the Note width, so it fits every board). Shown as a split-flap strip on your plugin's directory card. Colour markers like {66} count as ONE tile, not four characters.
_previews_comment: Literal board rows showing what your plugin looks like. Rows may be shorter than the board (padded with blanks) but never longer. Add a note_array entry if your plugin is composed for one.
